source_scope.scope_rule: Only direct child task directories of seed_baseline are read; directories containing '_backup_' and symlinks are excluded.

interpretation_boundary.warning: Repetition, an unchanged screenshot, explicit self-correction, failure, and reaching 50 steps are not individually or jointly proof that a prior step misled the agent. Misleading requires manual evidence alignment and downstream-use verification.

(?:made|make|keep making|am making|was making|have been making|had been making) (?:the same |this |a )?mistake|i (?:was|am) wrong|i messed up|messed up|oops|accidentally|by mistake|misclicked|misread|misinterpreted|misunderstood|mixed up|confused|stuck in (?:a )?loop|going in circles|wrong (?:place|page|screen|menu|app|account|post|item|button|channel|tab|direction|way|thing|option|icon|spot|view|user|profile|file|field|location|chat|contact|number)|that's not right|that was wrong)\b

fifty_step_retrieval_candidates.ranking_basis: Lexicographic retrieval ordering: presence of a three-repeat action cycle, number of conservative evidence dimensions, short cycle count, explicit-error count, reasoning-pair count, task name.
